_comment: Message of the day for CPMForge extensions. Fetched by @cpmf/motd. Targeting is applied CLIENT-SIDE: this document is identical for every reader, so the server never learns which product, tier or user asked. Shape and rules: packages/motd/docs/published-shape.md in cpmf-uips-vscode.

messages.title: CPMForge message channel is live
messages.body: This is a test message confirming the message-of-the-day channel works end to end. It is scheduled to disappear on its own.

messages.title: Object Repository lens: statistics and export
messages.body:
Repository statistics are available in the panel, and "Object Repository: Export Statistics" writes a Markdown report.

This message is targeted at one product and one version range, so seeing it anywhere else means targeting is broken.

messages.title: This message should NEVER be displayed
messages.body: Its thru date is in the past. If this ever appears, the time-window filter is not working.

messages.title: This message should NEVER be displayed either
messages.body: Its from date is far in the future. If this appears, the time-window filter is not working.

messages.title: Tier-targeted test message
messages.body: Aimed at the creator tier only. A build that does not know its tier must NOT show this — an unknown value never matches a restricted facet.
